description: This file defines CLI commands related to license management in the Mattermost server, including uploading, removing, and retrieving license information.

methods.name: uploadLicenseStringCmdF
methods.description: Handles uploading a license from a string argument.

methods.name: uploadLicenseCmdF
methods.description: Handles uploading a license from a file specified by path.

methods.name: getLicenseCmdF
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the current license information.

methods.name: formatLicenseTimestamp
methods.description: Converts epoch milliseconds string to human-readable date.
